historical_record.description: Built as an industrial building, recorded as occupied by Pelton Water Wheel Co. Engineered by W. W. Hanscom.
Earlier buildings on the site were destroyed in the earthquake and fire.
Storage buildings were added on the Alabama Street side.

historic_survey.survey: Showplace Square / Northeast Mission Historic Resource Survey (2011)
historic_survey.eligible_district: Northeast Mission / Showplace Square Industrial Employment District (proposed)
historic_survey.physical_integrity: 6 of 7 aspects retained, on the survey's scale
historic_survey.note: The survey rates the architecture 3 of 5. The 2009 context statement gives the status code 3CD; the 2011 survey data table gives 3CS. California Register criteria cited: 1, 3.
historic_survey.status_code_meaning: California Historical Resource Status Codes: a 1 or 2 means listed or formally determined eligible, a 3 means the survey judged it eligible, a 5 means locally significant, a 6 that it was found ineligible, and a 7 that it was not evaluated.
